findings.title: pr-decisions.ts teardown git subprocess inherits full process.env including daemon secrets
findings.detail: In src/orchestrator/handlers/pr-decisions.ts, the teardown lambda called execFileAsync('git', ['rev-parse', 'HEAD'], { cwd: worktreePath }) without setting env. The full daemon process.env (including ANTHROPIC_API_KEY, GITHUB_TOKEN, IFLEET_HMAC_SECRET) was forwarded to the git subprocess, making all secrets available to any git hook the worktree defines.
findings.fix_sketch: Add env: minimalGitEnv() to the execFileAsync options and import minimalGitEnv from @wahq/orchestrator-core/repos/manager.

findings.title: editor.ts git subprocesses have no timeout, blocking pipeline workers indefinitely on stuck git
findings.detail: In src/pipeline/editor.ts, commitEditorChanges() calls execFileAsync for git add -A, git diff --cached --quiet, and git commit with no timeout option. A stuck git subprocess (hung NFS, bad network, lock contention) blocks the pipeline worker thread indefinitely, consuming the worker slot and preventing any new tasks from being dispatched.
findings.fix_sketch: Add timeout: GIT_EXEC_TIMEOUT_MS (30000ms) to all three execFileAsync calls. Throw on timeout so the pipeline error boundary reports the failure rather than hanging.

findings.title: factory.ts git push and gh pr create have no timeout, blocking workers on network hangs
findings.detail: In src/pipeline/factory.ts, buildPrOpener() calls execFileAsync for git push and gh pr create with no timeout. A slow GitHub API response or network outage causes the subprocess to hang indefinitely, permanently blocking the pipeline worker thread that opened the PR.
findings.fix_sketch: Add timeout: GIT_PUSH_TIMEOUT_MS (60000ms) to git push and timeout: GH_CLI_TIMEOUT_MS (60000ms) to gh pr create.
